scope: Object editor same-field recommendations flicker during object switches
root_cause: Recommendations were requested only after publishing the incoming object. The object ownership guard temporarily returned an empty recommendation map, removing the section until a second asynchronous update.
changes: Read the target object and its recommendations in parallel, and publish form values, template, recommendations and readiness together.
Retain the previous complete, inert form while the incoming snapshot loads; do not clear the recommendation section between responses.
Use the editor request generation and account session guard for recommendation reads, including the new-object path.
Handle recommendation transport and processing failures independently, allowing editing without recommendations rather than failing the form.
Keep source exclusion, localized field matching and the existing per-object remasking lifetime; do not introduce a shared decrypted-value cache.

validation.regression_reproduction: Original implementation failed 5 of the initial 6 controlled request tests; the new-object behavior passed.
validation.unit_tests: 56 passed in 5 files, including 8 new cases for request ordering, stale results, failure degradation, malformed responses, vault locking and new-object recommendations.

production_browser.recommendation_cases: 4 new scenarios sample every animation frame through object-first, recommendation-first and skipped-object responses; every sampled visible editor has its matching recommendation list, with no empty or misattributed frame.
production_browser.preservation: Source exclusion, fill action, sensitive-value remasking, repeated selection without a new recommendation request, optional failure fallback and absence of page errors passed.
production_browser.existing_regressions: 26 existing inspector, chronological history/attachment handoff, action alignment, sidebar preview and continuous-name-scroll tests passed.

validation.diagnostics: The first preview-service attempt did not respond to HTTP and was stopped. An initial production run exposed a missing optional-response processing fallback; this was fixed and the complete 30-case suite passed afterward.
validation.native_acceptance: No new Windows or macOS native executable acceptance was performed; production browser platform fixtures were used.

delivery: One isolated fix directly on main, followed by commit and push; no feature branch or pull request.
